what: does reading the graph before entry actually separate winners from losers? Each closed trade's graph state is reconstructed from the tape AS OF ITS ENTRY (nothing after the entry is visible to the reconstruction, so no hindsight can leak in), then outcomes are graded inside each bucket.

coupling_status.statement: as of 7.1.4 the graph is a DISPLAY, not an input: CHART_INTEL.json is read by the dashboard and by nothing in the selection path. Sleeves select on confidence score, dip depth, geometry verdict, bounce reliability, reach-vs-cost and trend sign. Peaks, floors, ceilings, peak trajectory and cadence phase are drawn but never consulted.

peak_trajectory.why: entries taken at RISING averaged -0.472% vs -1.692% at FALLING (spread 1.220% over n=472) — reading this before entry would have separated winners from losers

trend.why: entries taken at SIDEWAYS averaged -0.117% vs -2.371% at DOWN (spread 2.254% over n=483) — reading this before entry would have separated winners from losers

cadence_phase.why: entries taken at JUST_PEAKED averaged +0.576% vs -1.790% at PEAK_DUE (spread 2.366% over n=452) — reading this before entry would have separated winners from losers

range_position.why: entries taken at HIGH_THIRD averaged +0.621% vs -2.149% at LOW_THIRD (spread 2.770% over n=483) — reading this before entry would have separated winners from losers

floor_support.why: no meaningful separation between buckets (spread 0.772% over n=445) — on this evidence the feature does not yet distinguish good entries

ceiling_overhead.why: entries taken at UNDER_TESTED_CEILING averaged -0.149% vs -1.802% at CLEAR_OVERHEAD (spread 1.653% over n=444) — reading this before entry would have separated winners from losers

next_step: EVIDENCE FOUND: peak_trajectory, cadence_phase, range_position, ceiling_overhead now separate winners from losers and are still not consulted at entry. These are the features to gate on next — with a knob, a kill switch, and an A/B, never silently.
honesty: this audit grades entries the system already took; it cannot say what would have happened on entries it never took. It answers 'did reading the graph help?', not 'is the graph complete?'
